notes.title: Preview of Mod Tools
notes.content:
Please note, the Mod Tools Currently in Development, The development of the mod tools began after the Early Access release and are still in early stages. Changes are to be expected to features and editors before made publicly available. Expected in 2024. Please note that the mod tools are not part of the game itself, but a suite of tools that anyone can use to run in browser (on windows) to modify the contents of the game.

[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Images/Screenshots/home.png[/img]

[h1]World Builder[/h1]
[h3]The heart of the mod tool. Create your own custom metroidvania world intuitively, piece by piece.
[/h3]
[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/worldbuilder-1-map.gif[/img]
[h2]Intuitive Map Placement
[/h2]Drag and drop rooms into place viewing side by side the map and the rooms. Lines connect doors ensuring even when moving rooms around you know the flow of the game.

[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/worldbuilder-2-doors.gif[/img]
[h2]Doorway Linking Made Easy
[/h2]Effortlessly connect rooms with doors, ensuring seamless exploration for players.

[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/worldbuilder-3-enemies.gif[/img]
[h2]Populate With Foes and Goods
[/h2]Add custom enemies and game objects to the world, ensuring your world is as treacherous as it is expansive.


[h1]Room Editor
[/h1][h3]The building blocks of your world. Design the collision layers of rooms and optionally label with routes for use with the base game's generator and route solver.[/h3]


[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/roomeditor-1-tileset.gif[/img]
[h2]Tile-Based Collider Placement
[/h2]A familiar tileset editor for placing colliders. Standard operations like copying, flipping, and rotating are at your disposal.

[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/roomeditor-2-Nodes.gif[/img]
[h2]Node Configuration
[/h2]Set up room nodes and doors, allowing you to set hidden nodes for creating secret areas.


[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/roomeditor-3-routes.gif[/img]
[h2]Route Mapping
[/h2]Detail the requirements for traversing between nodes, this optional step is useful for randomizers and creating data that can be used for training machine learning models which generate tile configurations from labels alone.





[h1]Tileset Rules Editor
[/h1][h3]Refine every corner of your realm with precision. Customize the rules that govern tileset placement in rooms.[/h3]



[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/tileset-1-upload.gif[/img]
[h2]Easy Tileset Upload
[/h2]Upload your own tilesets, making them readily available for all your room designs. Create a custom tileset rules, or duplicate one that already exists just changing the uploaded sprite.



[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/tileset-2-rules.gif[/img]
[h2]Collider Pattern Matching
[/h2]Decide which tile fits each collider pattern, ensuring gameplay and visual consistency across all rooms and saving time by removing the redundancy of basic aesthetic tile placement.



[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/tileset-3-room%20tester.gif[/img]
[h2]Room Preview
[/h2]Test your tileset rules on any room, tweaking and refining until every detail aligns with your vision.


[h1]Region Editor
[/h1][h3]Transform every space with layers of depth, breathing life into every corner of your world.
[/h3]

[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/parallax-1-adding.gif[/img]
[h2]Parallax Customization
[/h2]Upload images for each layer and define specific properties to capture the depth of a region.



[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/parallax-2-preview.gif[/img]
[h2]Region Preview
[/h2]Adjust, refine, and perfect your regions with the ability to load rooms and view how a specific view would look in game, eliminating guesswork from the design process.


[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/parallax-3-tiles.gif[/img]
[h2]Tileset Rules Integration
[/h2]Apply and blend multiple tileset rules to a region, ensuring visual consistency and enhancing the distinct identity of each area.


[h1]Sprite Sheet Editor
[/h1][h3]Upload sprite sheets and define animations with precision easily allowing the creation of custom enemies and items.[/h3]


[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/sprite-1-loading.gif[/img]
[h2]Simple Sprite Upload
[/h2]Get your artworks game-ready in a snap. Seamlessly upload sprite sheets and initiate the animation process with ease.

[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/sprite-2-frameproperties.gif[/img]
[h2]Frame Properties
[/h2]Adjust properties for changing the timing of the animation, as well as set triggers that could be used for events in the game that occur only on specific frames.


[h1]Game Object Builder
[/h1][h3]Unleash your inner game developer with our node-based system and craft intricate game objects with ease.[/h3]

[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Images/Screenshots/NodesSword.png[/img]
[h2]Node-based System
[/h2]Create new game objects with our flexible node system or modify existing ones allowing for the creation of custom enemies, items, and more.

[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/node-3-contextual.gif[/img]
[h2]Contextual Events and Actions
[/h2]Connect color coded sockets and drag sockets to create nodes, events, or actions related to that socket. Allowing for maintaining flow during design and only providing useful options.

[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Images/Screenshots/TerronLogic.png[/img]
[h2]Create and Customize Enemies
[/h2]Breathe life into your adversaries. Design unique behaviors, patterns, and actions that are as complex or simple as you want.

[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Images/Screenshots/EntryMainExit.png[/img]
[h2]Entry, Main, and Exit Phases[/h2]
State machines include by default 3 phases which can be easily utilized to capture the Anticipation, Execution, and Recovery of an action to prevent creating bloated state machines. Use all 3 per state or just 1 or 2.

[h1]Variations Editor
[/h1][h3]"Variety is the very spice of life." Dive deep into customization, fine-tuning game objects to quickly create unique variations of game objects.[/h3]

[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Images/Screenshots/Exposable.png[/img]
[h2]Expose Variables
[/h2]Expose variables from the Game Object Builder to allow for quick adjustments in creating unique variations, allowing you spend less time tinkering and more time creating.


[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Images/Screenshots/Variations.png[/img]
[h2]Create Variations
[/h2]Modify the exposed variables to create variations of the game object, allowing for the creation of unique enemies, items, and more.


[h1]Item Editor
[/h1][h3]Design items that players will cherish, be it for their utility or the stories they tell.[/h3]

[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Images/Screenshots/Items.png[/img]
[h2]Craft Unique Items
[/h2]Set details and upload icons for items. Set stats and apply overrides to game object variations that would be spawned when this item is used.

[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Images/Screenshots/ItemsInGame.png[/img]
[h2]In Game View
[/h2]Adding items quickly allows them to be used in game and tested, allowing for quick iteration and refinement.


[h1]Generator
[/h1][h3]"Imagination's blueprint." Harness advanced AI tech to produce inspiring visuals tailored to the game's art style. (Comfy UI, SDXL, and rembg to be acquired and installed separately)[/h3]


[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Images/Screenshots/Generator.png[/img]
[h2]AI-Powered Image Creation
[/h2]Connect to Comfy UI's API and use custom workflows for Stable Diffusion XL to generate unique art assets for the game. Utilize a LoRA (Low Rank Adaptor) specifically trained on art from Project Delta to generate creatures and objects that fit within the artstyle of the world.

[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Images/Screenshots/SeamlessTiled.png[/img]
[h2]Seamless Tiled Parallax Generation
[/h2]Generate the base of assets you could use for parallax which are seamlessly tiled, allowing for easy parallax creation.


[h1]Image Processor
[/h1][h3]Refine art assets to seamlessly blend with the game's distinctive style.
[/h3]

[img]https://projectdelta.studio/Assets/Gif/processor.gif[/img]
[h2]Quickly Process to the Game's Palette
[/h2]Resize larger images to be pixel perfect and compare size to the game's player. Then convert the image to the game's specific palette, ensuring a consistent and harmonious visual experience throughout. Finally refine the lighting and contrast to meet your vision before saving the processed image for animation or direct use in game.

notes.title: Update 2023.09.02
notes.content:
MAJOR:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where you could leave the final boss' room before the ending sequence started which would prevent you from being able to see the game's ending.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2023.06.26
notes.content:
[Major]

- Pausing the game when pausing
- Vaporia T2 require kill enemy room post input item now has requirement with input item to prevent softlock in room

[Medium]
- Defaulting terminal to having the "Homeworld" area select selected to make escape from Aion Station during the beginning escape sequence more obvious

Major:

[list]
[*]Fixed issue where inputting certain input orders on Super would break that file's ability to be used
[*]Added clearing inputs for on the world list where the world list says "Edit" for those affected by this bug
[*]Removed Require Kill Enemies requirement if third input on Super is Ice
[*]Adjusted tiles on a GHZ room
[/list]

Added full keyboard mapping:

Keyboard Key    -   Controller Glyph    -   Action 

Control Mapping:

Left Arrow      -   Left Arrow Move     -   Move
Right Arrow     -   Right Arrow Move    -   Move
Up Arrow        -   Up Arrow            -   Accelerate up quicker / Look Up (hold)  
Down Arrow      -   Down Arrow          -   Duck / Look Down (hold)
A               -   Bottom Face Button  -   Jump / Confirm (in menu)
Space           -   Right Face Button   -   Run / Spin Jump (while in air) / Back (in menu)   
S               -   Left Face Button    -   Shoot
D               -   Top Face Button     -   Lay Bomb
Q               -   Left Shoulder / L1  -   Angle Bow
Left Shift      -   Right Shoulder / R1 -   Sanguki Arrows
Left Control    -   Left Trigger / L2   -   Ascend
W               -   Right Trigger / R2  -   Grapple
Tab             -   Left Stick Click    -   Cycle Selector Type
C               -   Right Stick Click   -   Toggle Selctor
1               -   Left Analog Up      -   Select Top for Selector
2               -   Left Analog Right   -   Select Right for Selector
3               -   Left Analog Left    -   Select Left for Selector
4               -   Left Analog Down    -   Select Down for Selector
Return / Enter  -   Right Menu Button   -   Pause
Right Shift     -   Left Menu Button    -   Open / Close Map

[b]SEED BREAKING CHANGE[/b]

Note: this update changed the routing in some rooms. This has a butterfly effect on world generation. Seeds that were previously generated will no longer produce the same outputs as previous versions.


[b][Major][/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted routing for save rooms that had a climb requirement to remove requirement. Game was not taking into account in some cases that you needed the abilities to escape causing potential softlocks
[/list]

notes.title: 2023.06.17f4
notes.content:
[Game Breaking]
Removed parsing as a way to select timescale using enhance percept. On some machines this was causing arrow selector to throw an exception on initialization, preventing you from using the arrow selector at all. The code is now using a new component which stores the float value instead of trying to parse from the object's name (which was a pretty hacky way to try and do that in the first place)

notes.title: 2023.06.17f1
notes.content:
[Major]
[list]
[*] Workaround for PS controllers:
[*] Added an alternative way to select different practice (bomb) type. In the event that a controller's analog stick is not registering. You can now press in the right stick to toggle the selector indicator as an alternative to using the left analogue stick. Pressing the right stick will both open and close the menu while allowing the dpad to select which ammo type you are using.
[/list]

[Medium]
[list]
[*]Changed Recollection map structure to allow you to access the shop before going to Ascension
[/list]
